scope: Completed numerical grid only; not proof timing, not new experiments. Means across dependent update requests; do not interpret request counts as independent trials.
comparison: All three datasets, both ages, both methods and both ranks retained. Agreement is with exact quantized nearest-center assignments, not ground-truth class labels.
original_workload: Higher coverage in these refitted workloads does not demonstrate that the original 61.63% coverage workload has been repaired.
timing: Do not combine the original 5.08x result or the standalone N128 2.07x result with these grid accuracies as though they were measured together.
